DESKTOP ORGANIZER - v31

HUD Live now includes the DeskNest desktop organizer. It runs inside HudWall.exe:
one tray icon, one Windows startup entry, one Exit.

WHAT IT DOES
- Folder portals: a frame on the desktop showing a live view of any folder.
  Double-click to open, drag items out, drop files in to move them (Ctrl = copy),
  Del sends to the Recycle Bin, F2 renames, Ctrl+F filters.
- Shortcut fences: desktop icons dropped on a fence move off the desktop into the
  fence. "Move back to desktop" or deleting the fence returns them.
- Tabbed launcher: Ctrl+Alt+Space (or left-click the tray icon). Type to search
  all tabs, Enter launches, drop apps on a tab name to file them there.
- Auto-sort rules: new desktop items are moved into folders by extension, name or
  regex. "Add common rules" sets up Images, Documents, Archives, Installers...

HUD THEME
Frames and the launcher are drawn as JARVIS panels: square corners, accent border,
corner brackets and Consolas headings. Their colors follow the HUD theme of the
monitor each frame sits on (Monitors > display > Theme), and change as soon as the
theme changes. A spanning HUD uses the primary display's theme everywhere.
Right-click a frame title > Color > HUD theme to follow the HUD; the other colors
are fixed tints that keep the HUD border and brackets.

TRAY > DESKTOP ORGANIZER
Open launcher, New folder portal, New shortcut fence, Show frames,
Auto-sort new desktop items, Edit auto-sort rules, Sort desktop now,
Show desktop icons, Bring frames back on screen, Open organizer settings folder,
Run desktop organizer (turn the whole organizer off or on).

VOICE (say Jarvis first)
- Jarvis open launcher / close launcher
- Jarvis sort desktop          (also: tidy up my desktop, clean up desktop)
- Jarvis auto sort on / auto sort off
- Jarvis edit sort rules
- Jarvis show frames / hide frames      (fences and portals too)
- Jarvis bring frames back
- Jarvis new fence
- Jarvis new portal            (asks for a folder)
- Jarvis new portal for downloads / documents / pictures / music / videos / desktop
- Jarvis show desktop icons / hide desktop icons

MOVING FROM THE STANDALONE DESKNEST
Your existing layout, launcher tabs and rules are kept: they stay in
%AppData%\DeskNest\config.json. On first start HUD Live removes the standalone
DeskNest's own startup entry. If the standalone DeskNest is still running, HUD Live
waits and takes over as soon as you exit it from its tray icon. Frames that used
DeskNest's stock Graphite or Midnight colors switch to the HUD theme; custom colors
are kept. The standalone DeskNest.exe can then be uninstalled or deleted.

FILES
Layout and settings: %AppData%\DeskNest\config.json (edit "Hotkey" there while
HUD Live is closed). Organizer log: %AppData%\DeskNest\desknest.log.
On/off switch: assets\organizer.json.
